# Jubilees Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Abraham's Final Instructions to His Sons

---

**20:1** And in the forty-second jubilee, in the first year of the seventh week, Abraham called Ishmael and his twelve sons, and Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons of Keturah and their sons.

**20:2** And he commanded them that they should observe the way of the LORD, and work righteousness, and love each his neighbor, and so act with all mankind, that they should each so walk with-regard-to them — doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.

**20:3** And that they should circumcise their sons according to the covenant which he had made with them; and that they should not deviate to the right hand nor to the left of all the paths which the LORD had commanded them.

**20:4** And that they should not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan, for the seed of Canaan would be rooted-out from the land.

**20:5** And he told them of the judgment of the giants, and the judgment of the Sodomites — how they had been judged on account of their wickedness, and had died on account of their fornication, and uncleanness, and the corruption among themselves.

**20:6** "And guard yourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, and from all the pollution of sin, lest you make our name a curse, and your whole life a hissing, and all your sons be destroyed by the sword, and you become accursed like Sodom, and all your remainder be made to cease from under heaven."

**20:7** "For by reason of fornication and uncleanness and the corruption of idolatry, they have been brought to ruin, and become a reproach."

**20:8** "And now I make you to swear by the great oath — for there is no oath which is greater than it, by the name glorious and honored and great and splendid and wonderful and mighty — that you will not fear anyone of flesh; that you will worship only the LORD your God, who has created heaven and earth and all things.

**20:9** And that you will work righteousness in all things, and will walk in uprightness, and that you will not be led astray by impure spirits, for these will seduce you before him."

**20:10** And he divided all his possessions between Ishmael and Isaac on that day, and he gave the greater portion to his son Isaac, and Ishmael and his sons and the sons of Keturah received their share from the hand of Abraham.

**20:11** And Abraham gave to Ishmael and to his sons and to the sons of Keturah gifts, and sent them away from his son Isaac, that they should go to the country of the east.

**20:12** And he gave to his son Isaac all his possessions.

---
*EMET notes: Ge'ez construct-chains rendered with hyphens. "Fornication" (zemmut) is the standard Jubilees term for sexual boundary violations. The "great oath" by God's name echoes Jubilees' oath theology.*
